notes_for_editor: One source only. The name hopewell is the list author's label (names for towers 73 and above are his own), not a name confirmed by a map or agency; the 'hopewell' name may not be the tower's name. The NHLR Georgia page (29 lookouts) does not list it. A web search for Hopewell in Baldwin County returned only Fulton County pages, so no Baldwin County history was found. The BLL and gfc numbers suggest the Georgia Forestry Commission's records covered this site, but no GFC record was read. Correction proposed for the registers field, for a human to apply or reject. Next step if wanted: a GFC records request, or a Baldwin County search on the GFC number.
